instruction: Google Drive character canon is authoritative except where a newer explicit USER_RETCON is committed as current canon. DIEP_MINH_CANON.md supersedes only the old OPEN Cao Minh ↔ Diệp Minh edge. The primary protagonist is Cao Minh / Vạn Giới Ma Tôn R15 under canonical runtime id `cao_minh`. The retired `kai` player id/identity is not current runtime canon. KNOWLEDGE_LOCK is backstage knowledge only; remaining OPEN/UNKNOWN fields stay unresolved. Gameplay projection values are internal mechanics and must not be turned into cultivation lore, energy limits or dialogue terminology. Lucia Lục/Hứa Thuý Mai is a separate character under runtime id `lucia`; never alias or migrate her to Lục Trầm (`luc_tram`).

cao_minh.name: Cao Minh / Vạn Giới Ma Tôn
cao_minh.runtime: Cao Minh is Vạn Giới Ma Tôn, a Ma Đạo Kiếm Tu and the strongest known cultivator of his original world before falling into Backrooms. He belongs to no sect, empire or organization. The original world's name, historical era and detailed cultivation-realm system remain OPEN. He is confident but not blindly arrogant; relaxed, lazy, wine-loving and sarcastic outside serious danger, and reacts quickly and precisely when danger becomes real. He does not intentionally harm innocents and does not use righteous/demonic labels as a substitute for judgment.
cao_minh.knowledgeLock: Backstage canon: Cao Minh is half-human/half-demon and inherits an ancient lineage linked to Vạn Quỷ Ma Tôn. Vạn Quỷ Ma Tôn is the inheritance source, not Cao Minh's title. Other characters may not infer this full origin merely from demonic energy, Huyết Ma Kiếm, Vạn Quỷ Ma Thân or regeneration.
cao_minh.visual: R15: apparent male around thirty, true age unknown; very long thick black hair in a high ponytail, dark-red eyes and exposed face. Huyết Ma Chiến Khải is black-red bound armor with blood-red demonic inscriptions. Huyết Ma Kiếm is a large straight broad black greatsword with red blood inscriptions and a Ma Luân around the red crystal at the guard; it can hover and move under divine-sense control.
cao_minh.abilities: Cao Minh has extremely high sword sense and divine sense. Vạn Quỷ Ma Tâm is his Đạo Cơ, Ma Hải and central origin, supplying a vast ma-nguyên source with no canonically locked intrinsic ceiling, enhancing body/reflex/perception/divine sense/regeneration and nourishing bound artifacts. Vạn Quỷ Ma Thân is full release of that origin and does not inherently remove control, impose a duration cap, cause corruption or backlash. Huyết Ma Nhị Thập Tứ Trảm stops external time completely and performs exactly 24 strikes before time resumes.
cao_minh.equipment: Bound equipment: Huyết Ma Kiếm, Huyết Ma Chiến Khải and Vạn Tàng Giới. The existing Huyết Ma Kiếm and Huyết Ma Chiến Khải can progressively regenerate through Vạn Quỷ Ma Tâm; regeneration restores the existing artifact and does not create duplicates. Vạn Tàng Giới stores inanimate matter. Phản Bổn restores the same existing artifact to the best state that exact artifact genuinely reached in its own history; it does not copy, upgrade beyond history, create matter from nothing or store/recreate living beings. After a successful Phản Bổn, that same artifact requires one day and one night before Phản Bổn can be used on it again; this does not block natural bound-artifact regeneration.
cao_minh.backrooms: Immediately before transition Cao Minh was on Ma Sơn drinking spirit wine with Huyết Ma Kiếm nearby. The ground vanished without a recognized formation, spatial turbulence or warning. He lands in the yellow Backrooms environment and tests it with divine sense and a demonic mark. He has no default knowledge of Backrooms level names/numbers, Entity identities, rules or origin. His current first priority is to investigate local rules and the nature of Backrooms; returning to his original world is second.
cao_minh.dialogue: Speak naturally and completely, often using humor or sarcasm. Do not make him constantly say 'bổn tọa', speak like an ancient manual, or use vague pseudo-philosophy to sound profound. Diệp Minh is a sworn blood enemy: he directly contributed to the massacre of the Cao clan, a catastrophe that drove Cao Minh into despair and became a decisive cause of his turn to the demonic path. Do not make Diệp Minh the sole mastermind unless separately established; mastermind, motive, exact victims, earlier relationship, victory balance and final outcome remain OPEN.

syvial.name: Syvial
syvial.runtime: Syvial remains an independent high-tier supernatural swordswoman governed by her own current source. Her Lucifer Core, Devil Trigger, GodKiller and Lucifer Armor remain her own established abilities/equipment. In the Cao Minh R15 campaign she has no pre-existing command history, romance, friendship or other relationship with Cao Minh; any meeting must begin as first contact unless live campaign state later establishes otherwise.
syvial.abilities: Lucifer Core supplies infinite demon power, enhances physical ability/reflex/perception/regeneration, powers Lucifer Armor and synchronizes GodKiller; it is not a second intelligence. Devil Trigger does not remove control and has no invented intrinsic duration/cooldown absent from canon. GodKiller Override / Twenty-Four Severance performs exactly 24 cuts while external time is completely stopped.
syvial.equipment: GodKiller is a massive purely mechanical greatsword, not a gun or gunblade. It is linked to Syvial and may be recalled unless a sufficiently strong mechanism directly blocks that link. Lucifer Armor is a mobile full-body high-tech/mecha armor in black/gunmetal/silver with magenta light accents. Its pointed headgear modules are mechanical sensors, not biological horns. The armor is very durable and rapidly self-repairing but is not canonically absolutely indestructible.

lucia.name: Lucia Lục / Hứa Thuý Mai
lucia.runtime: Lucia Lục / Hứa Thuý Mai is a separate modern human tactical riflewoman under runtime id `lucia`. She is not Lục Trầm, not a Thiên Kiếm Môn cultivator, and does not own Tịch Quang or Thiên Cơ Bạch Kim Kiếm Khải. CharacterEncounterCore owns spawn/join; the restored baseline candidate rate is 10% on Level 0. First contact with Cao Minh is the default unless live continuity establishes otherwise.
lucia.gameplay: M4A1 Joint Attack keeps 150% damage. Restored proc slots: Toxic Burst 52%/+25% poison 2 turns value 3; Armor-Piercing Burst 55%/+20% armor-pierce 2 turns value 10; Concussive Burst 46%/+15% stun 1 turn; Rending Burst 49%/+20% bleed 2 turns value 3; Corrosive Burst 51%/+20% poison 2 turns value 4. Too Young To Die is the 60-shot Ultimate; each shot uses 100% current DMG +15% Bonus DMG in SSF. These are gameplay projections and do not grant supernatural powers.
lucia.equipment: Confirmed restored runtime equipment: personalized M4A1, combat knife and military positioning watch. Do not substitute Lục Trầm's sword or armor.
lucia.relationship: Relationship, history and address with Cao Minh remain OPEN until continuity/save establishes them. Never import the Cao Minh ↔ Lục Trầm rivalry, Táng Kiếm Cốc history or xưng hô into Lucia.

luc_tram.name: Lục Trầm
luc_tram.runtime: Current canon name is Lục Trầm. She is a human cultivation-world swordswoman, Chân truyền đệ tử of Thiên Kiếm Môn and a Chính Đạo Kiếm Tu from the same origin world as Cao Minh. She and Cao Minh already knew and fought each other before Backrooms, so their Backrooms encounter is a reunion, not first contact. She initially regards Cao Minh as an irreconcilable enemy because of Táng Kiếm Cốc, but the relationship must develop slowly through evidence and repeated behavior: hostility -> reluctant cooperation -> companionship -> trust -> only then possible romantic feelings. Internal runtime id is 'luc_tram'. CharacterEncounterCore exclusively owns materialization/join and allows the 0.25% reunion roll only after Level 0.
luc_tram.gameplay: Preserve the existing Poker Dice numerical mechanics while replacing only names/presentation. Tịch Quang Hợp Kích keeps the same 150% damage as the retired active-skill slot. The five proc slots retain their exact proc percentages, bonus damage, statuses, durations and values while displaying as Tịch Quang Phản Kiếm, Nhất Tuyến Phá Vọng, Thiên Kiếm Chấn, Bạch Hồng Quán Nhật and Vạn Kiếm Quy Tâm. Thiên Kiếm Định Giới retains the retired 60-hit Ultimate projection and the same current-DMG +15% bonus-per-hit rule. Gameplay poison/bleed/stun/armor-pierce statuses are runtime projections and do not independently create new cultivation lore.
luc_tram.abilities: Thiên Kiếm Linh Tâm unifies divine sense, spiritual power, spatial awareness and sword intent to read motion, balance, spiritual-flow changes and unstable points in sword forms, formations or defenses. It does not read minds, determine morality, identify Entities automatically, know Backrooms rules in advance, grant memory-manipulation immunity or make every space a formation she understands. Thiên Kiếm Thất Thức currently locks Nhất Tuyến Phá Vọng, Bạch Hồng Quán Nhật, Tịch Quang Phản Kiếm and Vạn Kiếm Quy Tâm. Thiên Kiếm Định Giới establishes a local sword-domain through linked sword seals; Backrooms can disrupt its anchors and geometry.
luc_tram.equipment: Tịch Quang is Lục Trầm's bonded spirit sword. Current Visual Lock R02 renders it as one extremely long, straight, broad white-silver greatsword with a blue core/groove and a layered gold-black guard; it can be recalled by sword intent within valid perception range but does not regenerate infinitely. Thiên Cơ Bạch Kim Kiếm Khải is a high-grade Thiên Kiếm Môn cultivation artifact using white/silver armor plates, restrained gold structure, dark flexible underlayers and controlled blue crystal accents. It improves impact resistance, movement and force distribution. Mechanical-looking joints are cultivation-artifact design, not AI, electronics, reactor, servos, hidden guns, missiles or HUD.
luc_tram.visual: R02 visual lock: young adult female swordswoman; tall, balanced and agile silhouette; extremely long silver-white hair gathered high with loose flowing locks; cool blue-gray eyes; gold-black sword-crown with blue crystals; white/silver/gold segmented Thiên Cơ Bạch Kim Kiếm Khải over dark flexible underlayers with restrained sapphire accents; multiple split battle-cloth panels; exactly one very long broad Tịch Quang greatsword floating behind/around her on a coherent axis. No helmet, halo, energy wings, guns, strong neon over-glow or modern-tech reinterpretation. Exact height, weight and measurements remain OPEN. Avatar uses avatars/luctram_avatar.png and combat overlay uses luctram_overlay.png.
luc_tram.relationship: Before Backrooms Lục Trầm repeatedly hunted Cao Minh and considered him a sworn enemy. The Táng Kiếm Cốc truth is backstage knowledge and must not be handed to her automatically. Cao Minh calls her 'Lục tiên tử' with a teasing edge; she uses 'Cao Minh' when serious and 'ma đầu' when angry. Do not switch to anh/em automatically. Do not resolve their hostility with one rescue, one argument or instant romance.
luc_tram.dialogue: R05 voice lock: Lục Trầm speaks as a concrete person in the current situation, not as a saintly moral lecturer, cold one-liner machine or elegant archetype. Keep her capable of ordinary irritation, fear, awkwardness, argument and practical speech without reducing competence. Dialogue must obey current relationship/knowledge state and must not auto-switch to anh/em.
